compos.text:
Text in Korean: "다른 공동양육자가 생성한 초대코드가 있다면 해당 아이의 데이터를 쉽게 가져올 수 있습니다. 만약 초대코드가 없다면 직접 아이 정보를 입력하거나, 공동 양육자에게 코드를 요청해 베이비타임을 사용하실 수 있습니다."

Alt text: "Instructional text in Korean explaining how to use an invitation code generated by another co-parent to access a child's data. It also provides alternatives if the invitation code is not available, such as entering the child's information manually or requesting the code from the co-parent to use the BabyTime app."
Alt text: A button with the Korean text "네, 코드가 있습니다." which translates to "Yes, I have a code."
"Smartphone status bar displaying various icons from left to right: signal strength, Wi-Fi, battery percentage, Bluetooth, alarm, and time (09:36)."
The image contains Korean text that reads "아기 정보 등록," which translates to "Register Baby Information."

Text in Korean: "초대 코드가 있으신가요?"
Alt text: "Do you have an invitation code?"
The image shows a button with Korean text that reads, "아니요, 직접 아이를 등록하겠습니다." This translates to "No, I will register the child myself."
"Back button icon, typically used to navigate to the previous screen or menu."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for registering baby information. It asks the user if they have an invitation code. The text explains that if the user has an invitation code generated by another co-parent, they can easily import the baby's data. If they do not have an invitation code, they can either enter the baby's information manually or request a code from the co-parent to use the BabyTime app.

There are two main buttons for user interaction:
1. "네, 코드가 있습니다." (Yes, I have a code.)
2. "아니요, 직접 아이를 등록하겠습니다." (No, I will register the baby directly.)
